title: Atlas launch scrubbed from the records

tellings.quote: There was no Atlas launch that day. Well, goddamn well there was because Robert found the found the files from Vanderberg using that particular that particular launch in detail.

plain: An Atlas missile launch from Vandenberg Air Force Base in California in 1964 is said to have been wiped from the official record. Bob Jacobs, who tells it as someone who took part in events that day, says officials claimed there was no Atlas launch that day, but that a researcher he calls Robert found Vandenberg's files describing that very launch in detail. He raises it to show that the record of what happened that day was deliberately scrubbed.
